prerequisites: Basic knowledge of work with PC (Windows 7, 8, 10 or Linux OS).

learning_outcomes.text: Students are going to gain improving of analytical and logical thinking and ability to create and write algorithms.

syllabus_topics: The concept of algorithm, the basic characteristics of the algorithm.
The method of dividing problems into subproblems.
Flowchart - symbolic algorithmic language for displaying of algorithm of processing of information.
Creation and writing of algorithms in specialized SW - step-by-step operation, verification of algorithms and the complexity of the algorithm.
assessment_rules: Active compulsory study of materials and elaboration of specific tasks by the end of the semester is required.
bibliography: TAUFER, I., HRUBINA, J., TAUFER, J. Algoritmy a algoritmizace: vývojové diagramy, sbírka řešených příkladů. Pardubice: Univerzita Pardubice, 2001.
LUKASOVÁ, Alena. Formální logika v umělé inteligenci. [s.l.] : [s.n.], 2003. 269 s. ISBN 80-251-0023-5. Pardubice: Univerzita Pardubice, 2001.
